why: GitLab CI uses a project-level default timeout (60 minutes). Heavy jobs should explicitly declare a timeout to prevent runaway builds and wasted CI minutes.
suggestion: Add a timeout to the job, e.g. timeout: 30m.
measurementHint: Monitor the job's typical duration and set timeout to a value that allows for normal variance but catches hangs.
aiHandoff: Review .gitlab-ci.yml job "build-app" and add a sensible timeout value.

message: Job "build-app" installs dependencies (npm) without a visible dependency cache.
why: Clean CI runners re-download and re-install dependencies on every run when the provider cache is not configured. The relative benefit depends on install duration and cache restore/save overhead.
suggestion: If this install path is expensive, configure GitLab CI `cache:` keyed on the lockfile and verify total job time improves.
measurementHint: Compare total job duration, not just install duration, before and after enabling dependency caching.
aiHandoff: Review .gitlab-ci.yml job "build-app" and test whether the CI provider cache improves total job time before keeping it.
